search_explanation: Searched agent/ k8s manifests, src (main, credentials, gateway, gateway_client, killswitch), config, .mcp.json, migrations and README for service accounts, SPIFFE IDs, token exchange, subject/actor claims, RBAC/IAM bindings and revocation. The agent calls tools and APIs under its own identity, so A01 applies.
note: Identity, token exchange and delegated subject are sound, but permission bindings and independent revocation of the agent principal are not defined in this repo.
